full_judgment: 2. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record appearing for the petitioner, submits that the learned Judges of the High Court Division wrongly discharged the Rule in spite of the fact that the allegations made in the petition of complaint even if taken on face value do not constitute any offence under section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 and section 417 of the Penal Code.
